title: The Cushman School
description:
This project, part of The Cushman School's Play to Learn capital campaign, built a two-story, 25,000-plus-square-foot facility combining indoor arts, athletics, and multi-purpose space.

The new building supports several of the school's signature programs: the Society and Me (SAM) Challenge, a four-year curriculum where students research global issues and design community-impact projects that culminate in the annual SAMx Showcase; the Young Coders Initiative, a student-founded nonprofit teaching coding to youth through local and international chapters; and the Innovation Center and AI Atelier, maker spaces built around robotics, digital design, and other emerging technology.
